description: Insertion of two roof lights in rear elevation and one access hatch in roof following removal of existing plant, railings and machinery
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: 10-303 098, 10-303 099,10303 005, 10303 006, 10303 007, 10303 008, 10303 009, 10303 105, 10303 106, 10303 107, 10303 108, 10303 109, Heritage, Planning and Access Statement received 5 December 2023.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Condition : 4 - The roof area of the building shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area.
Condition : 5 - The windows to be fitted on the rear roof face of the dwelling shall be black-framed and traditional, conservation-style.
